features.title: Zero-Trust PHI Security
features.description: Your data never leaves your environment. Deploy completely on-premise or within HIPAA-compliant VPCs. We never train on patient records.

features.title: Clinical-Grade Reasoning
features.description: We eliminate hallucination by forcing the system to strictly cite trusted medical literature, EHRs, and internal guidelines for every claim it makes.

features.title: Full Traceability
features.description: Every output, synthesized summary, and automated workflow is logged in real-time, providing a complete, immutable audit trail for compliance officers.
